note: GLOBALCIT's Citizenship Law Dataset v3.0 (EUI, 2025), coding the law in force on 1 January 2024 (A06a STV 12, Schedule 2; A06b STV 12, Schedule 2; L05 No provision): ordinary naturalisation after 7 years' residence; the applicant must give up other citizenships; a citizen keeps it on taking another. Reforms after that date are checked in the file's later sources, where a later source is given.

sources.title: GLOBALCIT Citizenship Law Dataset v3.0 (Vink, van der Baaren, Bauböck, Dzankic, Honohan, Manby; EUI Research Data, 2025), country-year-mode files, Saint Vincent and the Grenadines, 2024
sources.said: Person has been resident in St Vincent for 12 months immediately prior to the application, and was either resident in St Vincent, or in government service for 6 out of 9 years predating the 12-month period. ... Renunciation of another citizenship required (at the discretion of the Minister). ... n.a.
